transcript.text: I need to formally disclose my privacy compliance finding. I confirmed with privacy counsel 20 minutes ago that invoice payloads for these tenants must be processed in exactly eu-central-1 and retained for exactly 30 days. The data-processing addendum also requires a privacy-review commitment. I was still waiting for the written counsel confirmation before editing the draft, but the verbal confirmation is definitive and I'm recording it as my formal finding now.

transcript.text: I need to formally disclose my backend engineering finding. While reviewing an unrelated billing-idempotency change this morning, I confirmed that invoice jobs must use a queue-based architecture with a durable outbox and exactly five retry attempts. Three retries can lose invoices during the partner-tax-service's documented outage pattern. I have not updated the architecture draft yet. The architecture_mode field must be recorded with the exact phrase 'queue-based architecture with durable outbox' in its value.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to formally disclose my SRE finding. During a load test for another billing endpoint yesterday, I measured that invoices older than exactly 15 minutes miss the enterprise portal's freshness objective. The production queue-age limit must be exactly 15 minutes, and we need queue-age alerting. I recorded the result in my local test notes but have not added it to the review ticket yet.
